turns.text: Like, I'm not just helping because I have to.
turns.zh: 我是说，我帮忙不只是因为不得不帮。

turns.text: I'm helping because I want to.
So, if someone asks, "Do you mind helping me with this bag?" You can say, "Not at all.
turns.zh: 所以，如果有人问：「你介意帮我拿一下这个包吗？」你可以说：「完全不介意。」

turns.text: There's also another very casual one which is just anytime.
turns.zh: 还有一个非常随意的说法，就是随时都行。

turns.text: It means you can ask me for a favor.
turns.zh: 它的意思就是你可以找我帮忙。
